mechanism: The first completed subwindow of an active UTC-aligned 4h or day candle forms an accumulation range. A one-sided move is classified from completed information as rejected manipulation, accepted same-side distribution, or flat. FVG, order block and fixed-RR checklists are not entry gates.

selected_path.acceptance_confirmation: two consecutive completed 5m closes outside the frozen accumulation range
selected_path.entry: resting limit halfway between the breached accumulation boundary and confirmation close
selected_path.target: one accumulation-range extension beyond the breached boundary
selected_path.pending_expiry: end of active UTC day only while unfilled

execution.coarse_fill_rule: first later observable 1m price after activation

ml.development: fit 2021 -> forward 2022; fit 2021-2022 -> forward 2023; select worst forward log growth with at least 15 trades per forward year
ml.official_model: one frozen refit using resolved information through 2023-12-31
